description: Docked, tabbed side panel for the document editor hosting the Comments, Revisions, Versions, Properties, Outline, and Pages tabs. Each tab is toggleable with a count badge, and an edge toggle reopens the panel after it is closed.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Whether the side panel shell is open.

parameters.name: ActiveTab
parameters.description: Whether the side panel shell is open.

parameters.name: ActiveTabChanged
parameters.description: Currently active tab.

parameters.name: CommentsContent
parameters.description: Number of versions shown in the tab badge.

parameters.name: CommentsCount
parameters.description: Whether to show the right-edge reopen button when closed.

parameters.name: OnClose
parameters.description: Content rendered for the pages tab.

parameters.name: OnOpen
parameters.description: Raised when the side panel should close.

parameters.name: OutlineContent
parameters.description: Content rendered for the properties tab.

parameters.name: PagesContent
parameters.description: Content rendered for the outline tab.

parameters.name: PropertiesContent
parameters.description: Content rendered for the versions tab.

parameters.name: RevisionsContent
parameters.description: Content rendered for the comments tab.

parameters.name: RevisionsCount
parameters.description: Number of comments shown in the tab badge.

parameters.name: ShowComments
parameters.description: Raised when the active tab changes.

parameters.name: ShowEdgeToggle
parameters.description: Whether the page navigator tab is available.

parameters.name: ShowOutline
parameters.description: Whether the properties tab is available.

parameters.name: ShowPages
parameters.description: Whether the outline tab is available.

parameters.name: ShowProperties
parameters.description: Whether the versions tab is available.

parameters.name: ShowRevisions
parameters.description: Whether the comments tab is available.

parameters.name: ShowVersions
parameters.description: Whether the revisions tab is available.

parameters.name: VersionsContent
parameters.description: Content rendered for the revisions tab.

parameters.name: VersionsCount
parameters.description: Number of pending revisions shown in the tab badge.
